name: Landmarc Leisure Corporation Limited
about: Landmarc Leisure Corporation Limited engages in the entertainment, wellness, and education businesses in India. The company is involved in the development, production, marketing and distribution of feature films, documentaries, short films. It also operates Svastii Spa & Salon, a unisex wellness destination, as well as the Svastii Wellness Academy. The company was incorporated in 1991 and is based in Mumbai, India.
